item.title: Mewgenics is an infernal machine that runs on cats
item.description: One of the greatest things on earth is when you're talking to someone you sort of know and they quietly switch from talking about human friends or family members to talking about their cats. It's great because there's often no meaningful alteration in tone to tell you something has changed. item.title: Dragon Quest 7 Reimagined sands down every sharp edge of a prickly classic - making it delightfully approachable, but not without cost
item.description: To remake anything beloved is to walk a tightrope. There is always a delicate balance to be struck between keeping what made the original great intact and delivering on the remake's promise to modernise, improve and strengthen. It's such a hard task that one can be forgiven for being reluctant to undertake it even once, but in the case of Dragon Quest 7 Square Enix now faces down this conundrum a second time. Are they gluttons for punishment? Read more

item.title: Memory price rises have not impacted the Switch 2 yet, says Nintendo president, but warns about pressure "through the next fiscal year"
item.description: A Q&A between shareholders and Nintendo's president Shuntaro Furukawa has been released alongside February's quarterly financial report, in which the topic of rising memory costs was discussed. While the price hikes haven't impacted the Switch 2 yet, Furukawa states that might change if the trend continues into the next fiscal year. Read more

item.title: Don't sleep on Nioh 3's wonderful asynchronous multiplayer, a life-saver and unexpected death bringer in equal measure
item.description: Nioh's weird multiplayer has always been one of the most unique quirks of the Soulslike-cum-masocore series. item.title: Difficulty done differently: Cairn and Baby Steps deliver kinder, more generous masocore
item.description: For the past week, instead of actually relaxing in the evenings, I have been ascending the gnarled brute of a mountain in Cairn. item.title: Happy 10th birthday, XCOM 2, the most brilliant, frustrating game of its time
item.description: There's this magical moment that all XCOM 2 players experience. A member of your elite squad of sci-fi planetary defenders holds their machine gun right up at the face of some alien foe, probably a Muton, and somehow has only a 90 percent chance to hit it. Still, aim perfect, hands steady, they can't possibly miss, you think. Then they do, they always do. 100 percent guaranteed. F**k you, XCOM! I love you. Read more
